title: Kinhold Update: Fighting over an outpost
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is being built with Claude Code. This is after a few tweaks to combat in an outpost. Still a lot to work on! Enemy outposts and settlements have flags that you have to lower. When lowered, they stop spawning raiders and you can take over the outpost and build on it. The different colored voxels are different materials (in this case clay and salt and a whole lot of sand) and the gave has four biomes - this one is the desert!

comments.body: wait a minute, is this like runescape? style-wise?

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body:
It is not like runescape, it is not an MMO. Also, the combat AI testing is without the players character, as I am testing how the AI fights and interacts.  
Kinhold is a voxel based survival and settlement management game. All ground is 100% minable, all items are harvestable, all animals/NPC's are killable. When you start a settlement, you start with four villagers, two male and two female, and as long as you keep an eye on their needs and keep happiness up, it keeps fertility up - they create more settlers that go from infants to the elderly, and eventually die. While they live, they gather resources (including mining the voxel world!) for you, they go hunt animals or ranch them if you have built animal pens, they feed themselves, build their own dwellings and meeting places, and essentially live their own lives without you. However, you can call them to be your army to defend against enemy raids, or to fight enemy settlements.
